verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State is a government agency whose core product is the state's official legal registry for business filings, certificates of good standing, UCC filings, notary and lobbyist registration. Self-hosting it is a category error, because filings only have legal effect with the state authority itself. Nothing in the evidence shows any self-hostable software distribution, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
